About Bekah

Christian. Wife. Mother.
Incorrigible homebody.

Bekah has been writing since she was a little girl, but it wasn't until 2020 — when the world turned upside down and inside out — that she finally thought, why not try to write a book? She quickly learned that writing love stories is as addictive as reading them, and she's never once looked back.

When she's not writing, you can find her wrangling her three wildlings, baking her feelings, and making googly eyes at every baby she comes across.

The Books

Slow burn romance to make you snort in public and sob into your coffee. With a cocktail of heart, soul, and laugh-out-loud chaos, Bekah's books combine the hopeful swoon of a 2000s romcom and the delicious pining of an Austen novel.

Always, Forever

Two rivals. One project. One hundred percent chance of disaster.

When Finn Madison and Everly Vance agree to collaborate on a project for a client, there's only one thing they can agree on: this can only end in flames. But when the first spark flies, it's not at all the kind of fire they're expecting…
